steps.instruction: This is a pure rename of Todo.done to Todo.completed. It should not change behaviour. Look through commands.ts for any leftover reads or writes of a `done` property on a Todo, including untyped or `any`-cast access and object spreads/literals. Change each one to `completed` so that whatever list() and complete() did before with `done`, they now do the same with `completed`. Do not rename ListOptions.includeDone, and do not add or remove filtering in list() beyond what already existed. If list() never filtered by completion, leave it that way. Existing tests must keep passing.

input.reason: The only failure is in my own acceptance test. It assumed list() hides completed todos by default, and no existing test specifies that. A rename shouldn't add new behaviour, so I've taken that assertion out of the acceptance test. I'm also asking the commands owner to check for any leftover `done` field access so that whatever list() did before still works the same way after the rename.

content.text: The file is already fully migrated. No changes needed.
